d: Takshashila ke gurukul men aachary vishnugupt ke sanidhy men chandragupt shastravidya ka prashikshan le raha hai aur ab vah nipurn ho chuka hai. vahin takshashila ke mukhy pravesh dvar par hazaron ki tadat men sharnarthi jama ho chuke hain , ve alakshendr ke atyacharon se bhayagrast ho takshashila men sharan mang kar rahe hain - kya takshashila naresh unhen apne rajy men aashray denge ? dekhiye is bhag men.
